mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 48 degrees near Fireman's Park, with an air quality index of 52.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-range roadmap for housing and infrastructure, while also maintaining our city's strong Moody's Aa1 financial rating.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Puppets in the Park festival and the Dane County Farmer's Market happening tomorrow.
In a noteworthy update, officers arrested a 19-year-old man on October 3 after finding a stolen firearm inside his vehicle.
Today is a great day for a treat, so head over to Culver's when they open today at 10:00 AM to see what is on the menu for the flavor of the day.
